title: Penalty.
bodyText: Any person who violates this chapter shall be fined not more than $10,000 for each violation or imprisoned for not more than five years, or both.
bodyHtml: [§486B-4]  Penalty.  Any person who violates this chapter shall be fined not more than $10,000 for each violation or imprisoned for not more than five years, or both. [L 2006, c 78, pt of §21]
